name: Rus — eight-age rework
notes: Packaged eight-age sketch. Building tiers and their troop/equipment recipes are researched together. Specialist military unlocks are optional terminal side branches. Pre-modern means 1914–1970; Modern means present day. Prices, timers and small stat increases remain TBD, except unchanged Stone Age Coastal Navigation. Heavy cavalry starts with the available Druzhina roster in Early Medieval; unavailable earlier heavy-cavalry placeholders remain unavailable. Age-up requirements will be designed separately: do not require every optional leaf. Planner only; original trees and normal skirmish are unchanged.

technologies.name: Cargo Canoes
technologies.description: Unlock squad transport technology: squads use cargo canoes to cross water. No port is required to unlock this transport tier.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Port, War Canoes & Sea Trade
technologies.description: Unlock ports and their war-canoe and sea-trader recipes together. Ports create sea traders and warships and receive trade deliveries.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Coastal Navigation
technologies.description: Unchanged upgrade: improve squad transport hulls and sailing speed, military sailing speed and warship firing rate. Trade ships are unchanged.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Workshops & Stone Mining
technologies.description: Unlock/upgrade factories and mines together, including extraction and stone tools; no metal smelting. Factories create trade cargo, spawn overland traders, and smelt the available metals. No separate recipe unlock research.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Paths & Roads
technologies.description: Improve overland roads and trade-route infrastructure for this age. Exact road benefits remain TBD.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Overland Traders
technologies.description: Unlock/upgrade overland traders spawned by factories, with a modest improvement in cargo per trip and delivery efficiency. Exact numbers remain TBD.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Settlement Administration
technologies.description: Cities are buildable from the start. Improve city reserve generation and building health by 10%, and receiving capacity by 10%. This closes the Stone Age economic branch.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Diesel Submarines
technologies.description: Unlock submarines and their port recipe. This is an optional specialization; submarine improvements are included in the later Modern General Fleet Improvements node. No quiet-propulsion chain.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Pre-modern Factories & Mines
technologies.description: Unlock/upgrade factories and mines together, including extraction and industrial steel production. Factories create trade cargo, spawn overland traders, and smelt the available metals. No separate recipe unlock research. Blacksmiths can recycle pre-Napoleonic equipment into copper/tin or iron through explicit salvage orders.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Pre-modern Road Networks
technologies.description: Improve overland roads and trade-route infrastructure for this age. Exact road benefits remain TBD.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Pre-modern Overland Trade
technologies.description: Unlock/upgrade overland traders spawned by factories, with a modest improvement in cargo per trip and delivery efficiency. Exact numbers remain TBD.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Pre-modern Cities
technologies.description: Unlock/upgrade cities, which generate troop reserves and act as cargo drop-off/receiving points. Slightly improve reserve generation, receiving capacity and building health. This closes the age's economic spine.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Oil Wells & Offshore Rigs
technologies.description: Unlock oil extraction through oil wells and offshore oil rigs. The oil-rig unlock belongs to economics, not naval. Supplies fuel for the industrial-age army and fleet.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Pre-modern Infantry & Equipment
technologies.description: Unlock/upgrade barracks and arms factory together, including this tier's equipment-production recipes and barracks troop recipes: Mosin Nagant Squad, PTRD-41 Crew. These recipes require no individual follow-up unlocks.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Pre-modern Ranged Infantry
technologies.description: Upgrade the ranged recruitment building and its equipment/troop recipes together: DP-28 Crew.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Pre-modern Vehicle Depot
technologies.description: Replace the stable progression with vehicle-depot upgrades and the base light-vehicle recipe: Gun Trucks. Heavy and ranged vehicle recipes are separate optional side branches.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Pre-modern Fortifications
technologies.description: Unlock/upgrade this tier's gun nests, trenches and anti-aircraft emplacements together, with modest fortification durability improvements.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Pre-modern Siege Engineering
technologies.description: Unlock/upgrade the siege workshop and all siege/artillery equipment and recruitment recipes available in this age. No separate workshop or per-engine research. Requires ranged, cavalry/vehicle and fortification upgrades.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: T-34
technologies.description: Optional terminal unlock: T-34 and its equipment/recruitment recipe. No technology requires this node. Produced at the vehicle depot.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Pre-modern Airfields & Fighters

technologies.name: Pre-modern Bombers
technologies.description: Optional terminal unlock: this age's bombers and their production recipe. No technology requires this specialization. Pre-modern bombers can carry atomic bombs after Nuclear Weapons is researched.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Nuclear Weapons & Atomic Bombs
technologies.description: End-of-pre-modern unlock: nuclear weapons facility and A-bomb production/loading for bombers. Reuse the existing H-bomb artwork for a bomber-dropped atomic bomb. Bomber specialization is required to produce the delivery aircraft, but is not a research prerequisite of this node. Atomic bombs are produced at the nuclear weapons facility and loaded one per bomber for O: A-Bomb Run.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Modern Ports
technologies.description: Unlock the new port tier and automatically upgrade every existing port. Slightly increase receiving capacity, cargo-stock generation, land and sea cargo per trip, and building health. This node bundles the tier benefits; no separate port-building research.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Modern Missile Warships
technologies.description: Unlock this age's improved warship recipe at the upgraded port. This is the warship branch of the port upgrade.
technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: Modern Sea Traders

technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.

technologies.name: General Fleet Improvements

technologies.notes: Playable first pass. Costs and research durations follow the base-culture age pattern; the eighth age extrapolates its final tier by 25%. Balance remains tunable.
